applicationName.description: Empty = derive from the destination (zaehlwerk-<sha1[:8]>), so two clusters cannot collide in the management cluster's argocd namespace.

destination.description: Provide `server` (cluster URL) or `name` (registered cluster name) — at least one required. If both are set, the templates prefer `name`, so a consumer does not have to null out the chart default.

syncPolicy.description: CreateNamespace=true is required: the published base ships no Namespace, on purpose.

version.description: Tag of the published kustomize artifact; CI gives it and the container image the same release version, so this pins both.

hostname.description: FQDN patched into the HTTPRoute. zaehlwerk has no authentication — the route is the access control, so this belongs on an internal gateway.

sectionName.description: Listener the route attaches to. Omitting it would attach the route to every listener on the Gateway.

secretStore.description: Store the `zaehlwerk-panel` ExternalSecret reads from. Named per cluster (pattern vault-<cluster>), never plain `vault`.

allowedOrigins.description: Browser origins allowed to read the live match stream. Empty = none; upstream refuses the `*` wildcard.

panel.description: The scoreboard panel. All URLs empty = no panel, in which case the chart REMOVES OMNI_PITCHER_URL from the base's ConfigMap — zaehlwerk tests whether the variable is set, so an empty string would be dialled as a URL.

homerun2Namespace.description: Shortcut for homerun2 on the same cluster: derives both URLs from this namespace. An explicit URL wins.

omniPitcherURL.description: Where scored points go. Needs omni-pitcher's routing file to carry a `system: tabletennis` rule, else the scores land on `messages`.

catcherURL.description: The led-catcher zaehlwerk switches onto the tabletennis stream for the duration of a match.

reloader.description: Stakater Reloader annotation on the Deployment. zaehlwerk reads its config only at start, so without it a changed panel URL sits unnoticed. No-op without the controller.
